papers.evidence: 超箭图表示的模空间与稳定性，推广箭图表示
papers.tldr: 超箭图表示是有向超图上的向量空间与多重线性映射结构，推广了经典箭图表示，但其模空间和稳定性理论尚不完善。本文采用仿射GIT，在乘积一般线性群作用下刻画超箭图表示的（不）稳定性。作者进一步引入Harder-Narasimhan滤过，并推导出该唯一滤过的权重公式。所得公式可特化为箭图表示的HN斜率，为超箭图模空间与稳定性研究提供了系统工具。
papers.abstract_en: Hyperquiver representations are generalisations of quiver representations. They are directed hypergraphs with vector spaces assigned to vertices, and for every directed hyperedge, an assignment of a linear map from the tensor product of the source vector spaces to the tensor product of the target vector spaces. We study the moduli of hyperquiver representations, where we use affine GIT to describe the (in)stability of such objects under the action of a product of general linear groups. Our main result introduces the Harder-Narasimhan filtration of a hyperquiver representation. We also derive a formula for the weights of this unique filtration, which specialise to the Harder-Narasimhan slopes of a quiver representation.

papers.title_en: The center conjecture for cyclotomic Hecke algebras and cohomology of quiver varieties
papers.authors: Jun Hu, Andrew Mathas, Lei Shi, Ben Webster
papers.evidence: 研究箭图簇与分圆KLR/Hecke代数中心的表示论
papers.tldr: 本文研究分圆Hecke代数中心猜想：对无边环quiver，将Nakajima quiver variety上同调与分圆KLR代数的Jucys–Murphy中心同构。结合维数计数，在仿射A型中证明JM中心在特征0、特征不整除e及特征等于e时等于全中心。由此得到G(r,1,n)型分圆Hecke代数中心由JM元素对称多项式生成，并推广KPS猜想至整系数与正特征。
papers.abstract_en: For a quiver without edge loops, we construct an isomorphism from the cohomology of a Nakajima quiver variety with coefficients in an arbitrary field to the Jucys--Murphy center of the corresponding cyclotomic KLR algebra over that field. In affine type $A^{(1)}_{e-1}$, combining this with a dimension count shows that this Jucys--Murphy center coincides with the full center in characteristic $0$, when the characteristic does not divide $e$, and when the characteristic equals $e$. This follows from a geometric theorem showing that the sum of these cohomology rings is cocyclic as a module over an integral form of a loop algebra.   As a consequence, we prove that the center of a cyclotomic Hecke algebra of type $G(r,1,n)$ with $q\neq 1$ over any field is generated by symmetric polynomials in its Jucys--Murphy elements, and the same holds over any commutative domain in which $q-1$ is invertible. We also prove a generalization to the integral case of the conjecture of Krylov, Paegelow and Shlykov identifying the equivariant $K$-theory of the core of a Gieseker variety with the cocenter of the generic cyclotomic Hecke algebra, including the natural extension of this conjecture to positive characteristic.

papers.evidence: 有限维Taft代数及其模张量范畴的2-表示理论
papers.tldr: 本文研究Taft代数有限维模范畴的2-表示论，该张量范畴有两个左胞腔。上胞腔借助Etingof-Ostrik构造得到无限族互不等价单2-表示；下胞腔先半单化并识别出伴随sl2 Verlinde融合子范畴，再用ADET图代数对象与范畴Clifford理论分类正则精确不可分解模范畴，证明split Grothendieck群是完全不变量，最终识别两个胞腔的2-表示。
papers.abstract_en: We study the $2$-representation theory of the Taft category, the tensor category of finite-dimensional modules over the Taft algebra. This category has two left cells. We first classify suitable transitive modules over its based representation ring. For the upper cell, we recall a construction by Etingof and Ostrik giving an infinite family of pairwise nonequivalent simple $2$-representations. For the bottom cell, we pass to the semisimplification of the Taft category and identify a distinguished fusion subcategory with an adjoint $\mathfrak{sl}_2$ Verlinde category. Using algebra objects associated with $\mathsf{ADET}$-diagrams and categorical Clifford theory, we classify the regular exact indecomposable module categories of this semisimplification. For these regular module categories, the split Grothendieck group is a complete invariant. Finally, we identify the two cell $2$-representations of the Taft category.

papers.title_en: The classification of taut surface singularities via representations from logarithmic vector fields
papers.evidence: 利用固定箭图的表示对紧致曲面奇点进行分类
papers.tldr: 论文研究正规复曲面奇点的 taut 分类，目标是用表示论工具替代逐例分析。核心是在例外圈上考察对数向量场，并通过有限维表示把几何问题代数化。对双节点图，限制映射给出固定 quiver 表示，限制上同调可解释为扩张群，区间分解进一步把消去问题化到有理链上的插值。由此恢复 Laufer 分类，并在非有理情形下证明充分性。最终得到统一判据：图 taut 当且仅当每个解析实现都满足 H^1(5E,S_X限制)=0，且 5 是最小整数。
papers.abstract_en: We study logarithmic vector fields on exceptional cycles through finite-dimensional representations and recover Laufer's classification of taut normal complex surface singularities. For graphs with two nodes, restriction maps define representations of a fixed quiver, with dimensions bounded independently of the number of components and their self-intersections. We identify restriction cohomology with an extension group and use interval decomposition to reduce its vanishing to interpolation on a rational chain. These calculations determine the classification conditions, and vanishing on every analytic realization proves sufficiency, including the nonrational cases. The obstruction cycles also give a uniform criterion: a graph is taut if and only if $H^1(5E,S_X|_{5E})=0$ for every analytic realization, where $S_X$ is the ambient logarithmic tangent bundle. We prove that five is the smallest positive integer for which this criterion holds for all graphs.

papers.title_en: Approximability of Triangulated Categories under Separable Extensions
papers.authors: Mengzhen Zhu, Yuefei Zheng, Xianhui Fu
papers.evidence: 研究三角范畴与t-结构，属三角范畴理论核心
papers.tldr: 本文研究可逼近三角范畴在可分扩张下是否保持可逼近性。作者以 smashing、稳定可分的精确单子为框架，在右 t-正合条件下分析模范畴。关键结果是该模范畴仍可逼近，并由此在适当假设下得到 smashing 局部化诱导 recollement 的逆型结果。论文还证明可分扩张可限制到内在子范畴，为胶合定理的逆向研究提供新途径。
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we investigate the behavior of approximability under separable extensions of triangulated categories. Let $\mathcal{B}$ be an approximable triangulated category and let $\mathbf{T}$ be a smashing, stably separable exact monad on $\mathcal{B}$. We prove that if $\mathbf{T}$ is right $t$-exact with respect to a $t$-structure in the preferred equivalence class, then the category of $\mathbf{T}$-modules $\mathbf{T}\text{-Mod}_{\mathcal{B}}$ is again an approximable triangulated category. As an application, we show that, under suitable assumptions, a smashing localization functor on an approximable triangulated category induces a recollement of approximable triangulated categories, thereby yielding a converse-type result to the gluing theorem of Burke--Neeman--Pauwels. Finally, we prove that separable extensions restrict naturally to the intrinsic subcategories associated with approximable triangulated categories.
